status: WHICH LOOPS SUPPLY THE LADDER FACTOR (O8). The T.L Casimir of the 32 (x) 45 link has exactly 3 eigenspaces ([-32.0, -12.0, 4.0]), so the n-hop traced product is a sum of 3^n words and the selection rule is enumerable exactly: the enumeration reproduces (MG)^n to 7.4e-17 and F_10 = 0.019186 against V85's 0.019186. Census: 55326 words survive at n = 10 out of 3^10 = 59049, growing like 3.000^n. The factor splits into a per-word decay r = 0.2232 and a multiplicity rate mu = 2.981 (product 0.6652), so the loop factor is NOT one loop class: it is a sum over 55326 classes with the interference ratio ||sum||/sum|| || = 0.0788 at the root against 1.0000 with the Wilson phase off, and F_10 = 0.01919 at the root against 0.24337 at eta = 0 - the phase SUPPLIES the factor. the multiplicity-weighted extrapolation to length 170 gives 7.892e-31 against (1/16 pi)^17 = 1.198e-29: the counted loops MISS the ladder exponent by a factor 0.0659
